# Artes do Caminho da Serpente

Geradas com o ImageGen integrado e utilizadas diretamente pelo jogo.

- `loading-snake-way-v31.png`: cenário da tela de carregamento.
- `snake-way-map-v31.png`: mapa e prévia da missão Caminho da Serpente.

## Prompt da tela de carregamento

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: animated game loading-screen background behind a centered UI panel
Primary request: a beautiful wide 16-bit pixel art scene inspired by an early Dragon Ball adventure, showing Goku riding the golden Flying Nimbus toward the entrance of Snake Way in the Other World
Scene/backdrop: immense pale blue sky above luminous ivory clouds, a long red serpentine road winding into the distance, tiny floating rock islands, golden light on the horizon
Subject: small readable silhouette of Goku in orange gi riding Nimbus in the lower-right third; Snake Way creates a strong journey line through the image
Style/medium: authentic crisp 16-bit pixel art, visible square pixel clusters, stepped edges, limited bright palette, three-tone shading, no painterly smoothing
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape; keep the central 50 percent calm and low-detail so a cream loading card remains readable; richer scenery around outer edges
Lighting/mood: bright, adventurous, hopeful, clear daytime
Color palette: sky blue, cloud ivory, vermilion red, golden yellow, small emerald accents
Constraints: background artwork only, no UI, no panels, no text, no logo, no lettering, no watermark, no black bars, no blur, no gradients

## Prompt do mapa

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: campaign map artwork and mission preview for a pixel-art game
Primary request: a complete illustrated map of Snake Way in the Other World, readable as a journey route
Scene/backdrop: an enormous red serpent-shaped elevated road winding in several clear loops across an ocean of bright ivory clouds; celestial gate at the beginning on the lower-left, checkpoint shrine and two oni training grounds along the route, tiny King Kai planet at the far upper-right destination
Subject: Snake Way is the dominant continuous route; include a very small Goku marker traveling along it, plus subtle golden checkpoint circles
Style/medium: crisp authentic 16-bit pixel art, visible square clusters, limited bright palette, clean game-map readability, no smooth painting
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 slightly elevated/isometric view; route travels clearly from lower-left to upper-right; landmarks separated and easy to recognize when shown as a small preview
Lighting/mood: bright celestial daytime, adventurous and welcoming
Color palette: cobalt and cyan sky, ivory clouds, vermilion road, gold checkpoints, jade roofs
Constraints: map artwork only, no UI, no text, no labels, no logos, no lettering, no watermark, no black bars, no blur, no gradients
